design.motif: A coffee tasting work surface: fine uncoated cupping-paper fibers, soft ceramic-glaze micrograin and two broad incomplete translucent ring impressions of unequal size. Only a tiny muted warm brown accent. No cup, coffee beans, botanical illustration, text, wheel graphic or dark stains.

description.en: Fine uncoated cupping-paper fibers, soft ceramic-glaze micrograin and two broad incomplete translucent ring impressions of unequal size.
description.zh: 杯测纸纤维、细瓷釉与两道不完整的浅环痕呼应品饮过程，咖啡杯原标仍是唯一主体。

design.rationale: The existing object, character or historical mark remains unchanged. Only a supporting working surface is interpreted from the product's purpose; no replacement Logo is generated.

description.en: Bilingual coffee flavor wheel, origin atlas, brewing lab and tasting journal
description.zh: 双语咖啡风味轮、产地地图、冲煮实验室与本地品鉴手记

purpose.en: Explore coffee through an original interactive flavor wheel, compare origins and brewing recipes, and record tasting notes locally. Bilingual learning paths and a slow exhibition mode support sensory practice and shop displays.
purpose.zh: 通过原创交互风味轮认识咖啡，对照产地与冲煮配方，并在本地记录品鉴手记。双语学习路径与慢速展示模式支持感官练习和店铺大屏。

rights: Owner-commissioned Azure OpenAI generated decoration under applicable provider terms. No third-party reference image or font was submitted. Existing Logo, font and product rights are unchanged. Do not describe raster output as handmade SVG or assert exclusive trademark rights.

contrast.method: WCAG relative luminance on every native RGBA pixel composited over actual Hexly normal/hover surfaces, before the left-edge mask. Text remains fully opaque.

publication: Export-time record. Upload receipts and the site release establish subsequent publication.
